description: Add a missing take-profit and/or stop-loss to an OPEN perp position on HyperLiquid (one side or both). Triggers are market triggers covering the whole position unless size / tpIsMarket / slIsMarket say otherwise. The TP trigger must be on the profit side of the mark price and the SL on the loss side. Refused when that side already has a trigger (use modify_perp_order) or when there is no open position.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for AES encryption

coin.description: Asset symbol of the open position; builder-DEX assets as 'dex:ASSET'

size.description: Size the triggers cover, in contracts; omit for the whole position

slIsMarket.description: True (default) for a market trigger, false for a limit trigger

slPrice.description: Stop-loss execution price; omit to let the back-end set it

slTriggerPrice.description: Stop-loss trigger price; omit to add no stop-loss

szDecimals.description: Market size decimals (HL meta szDecimals); checks precision instead of letting the back-end round

tpIsMarket.description: True (default) for a market trigger, false for a limit trigger

tpPrice.description: Take-profit execution price; omit to let the back-end set it

tpTriggerPrice.description: Take-profit trigger price; omit to add no take-profit

name: add_position_tpsl
